description: Shared cases for the run type label check. label_words is the list both implementations hold, in this order: LABEL_WORDS in src/incident_awareness/collection/r1_pair_identity.py and $R1_LABEL_WORDS in scenarios/R1/run-common.ps1. For each case, word is the label word both report for value, or null when the value is accepted. The Python tests and the PowerShell guard read this one file. The file is ASCII: Korean is written as Unicode escapes.
